trust.detail: 0 of 40 test-set fixes and 0 of 40 fresh fixes are in the snapshots the setups learned from. The check does fire when it should: as positive controls it finds 24 of 40 dev fixes and 30 of 40 fresh fixes at HEAD.

trust.detail: Half the tasks are bugs fixed in sqlglot between April and October 2026, mined directly from the repo. The agent sees only the linked GitHub issue.
trust.title: Fresh 2026 bugs

trust.detail: Setups were tuned on dev tasks only, and the code refuses any test or fresh task in the tuning inputs. Test and fresh tasks were used for this final report.
trust.title: Dev and test kept apart

trust.detail: Only the repo's real tests decide a result, with test files reset first. Parsed results must match pytest's own summary, or the run can't pass. This caught 3 hidden-failure formats.
trust.title: A grader that fails closed

trust.detail: Each run starts from one snapshot with no git history and without the repo's own CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md, but the agent could still reach the web. Our audit of every tool call found 80 of 924 runs that reached the real fix or newer code, evenly across arms (12-16 per arm). Dropping every affected task leaves 51 tasks. No arm differs clearly from no setup on those tasks either.
trust.title: Clean workspaces, one gap found and measured

trust.detail: All 924 runs went through a hard-capped proxy that allows only Meta models. Its ledger total, $21.31, matches the sum of the runs' recorded costs.
trust.title: Every run metered
